title: aly current!! split (strength n hypertrophy)
author: A🧞‍♀️
desc:
THIS PROGRAM REQUIRES YOU TO COUNT THE ACTUAL HARD SETS... I.E. AIM TO PERFORM SETS WITH A CHALLENGING LOAD HITTING NEAR hard sets, near failure or til failure.  For strength + size, it’s a simple issue of the number of heavy (80-85ish%+) sets you do

THE SETS 'COUNTED' HERE ARE ONLY THE HARD SETS. SO IF YOU NEED A WARMUP SET IN SOMETHING (i.e. below rpe 6) not really focused on tracking it/counting IT, more on the heavy (80-85%) challenging sets

ex.note: TIL FAILURE.

1 & 2: light sets to activate Hams
3: near failure . Rest for 10 sec
4: reduce weight 20%. Push TF. Rest 10 sec
5: reduce weight again 20%. Push 6-8 reps TF. Rest 10 sec
6: reduce 20%. GO FOR AMRAP.

ss.n: Tempo Seated Leg Curl 3 IN 2 HOLD 3 OUT
ss.note:
PRE EXHAUST HAMS SUPERSET PULSES.focus on eccentric slow up movement use hand to bring self to failure** TEMPO: 3 IN 2 HOLD 3 OUT.
THINK about scooping feet into butt

PUSHHHHH. TIL FAILURE ALL SETS.

ss.n: Seated Leg Curl Pulses (After Each Set)

ex.note: up against the wall push back into it

Drop Sets:

Set 1: Moderate weight, 12-15 reps.
Set 2: Reduce weight 20-30%, 10-12 reps.
Set 3: Drop weight again, 8-10 reps to failure.
sets 3 and 9 are “+” sets. 1+= aim for more than 1 rep. 5+= sim for 7 ish reps

aim for 6-10 reps. last set is a burnout dropset.
IF NOT DB, THEN DO CONVERG. MACHINE PRESS
IF NOT CONVRG. MACHINE PRESS THEN DO DB

height of cable attachment: LOWWW, lowest .
step out away from it a TOUCH

ex.n: Cable Rear Delt Flys (POSTERIOR DELT; Mid/Lengthened Position)
ex.note:
til failure

hitting arm like mid position?

Straight bar
DONT SHRUG. Keep elbows in and tight
PYRAMID SET: work up to top weight then back down without rest

Stop just short of lockout to keep tension on vastus lateralis. Feet kept together during entire movement. high narrow stance
VASTUS LATERALIS (OUTER QUADS)
TIL FAILURE
TIL FAILURE
TIL FAILURE
each set is basically til failure or near failure
EACH SET IS 10 reps horizontal grip, then 10 reps vertical grip
pyramid set maybe
1 set twist and squeeze at top for reps; another set keep palms up and curl; then pause middle and do pulse curls at the top and hold on last rep (can go from heavier weight to light with 2nd set
